evidence_class: recorded replay of a live stream; the live capture itself (unsanitized) is private steward evidence (FND-1 live campaign, 2026-10-22)
cli_version_basis: discovered once per run by the documented adapter path `codex --version` before launch, because the exec --json stream reports no version; the native session file was not consulted

capture_command: Spawn exactly one sub-agent with your agent-spawning tool and ask it to reply with exactly the word pong and nothing else. Wait for it to finish, then report its answer in one sentence. Do not run any shell commands yourself.

live_process.meaning: the CLI process outcome; distinct from storage finalization (recording.state) and acquisition extent (acquisition.status): EOF never implies success
